legend.purpose: Every label, axis and panel heading.

motion.name: ease-land
motion.purpose: A new leader's emission line lands with one damped overshoot (700ms). The only overshoot in the system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled control per panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--bone, #e6e1d5); background: var(--bone, #e6e1d5); color: var(--ground, #0d0e0f); font: 500 14px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; transition: background-color .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--bone-2, #b0ab9e); border-color: var(--bone-2, #b0ab9e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--nm589, #ffc94a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Outline with H-alpha ink; isolated from neighbours by a seam.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #3a3d42); background: transparent; color: var(--nm656, #ff6460); font: 500 13px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover, .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { border-color: var(--nm656, #ff6460); outline: none; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Ground-coloured well with a legend label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-field span { font: 500 11px/16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--bone-3, #8d897d); } .ds-field input { height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--seam-strong, #3a3d42); background: var(--ground, #0d0e0f); color: var(--bone, #e6e1d5); font: 13px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--nm589, #ffc94a); outline: none; }

components.name: Line glyph
components.description: Node state as line form: doubled leader, solid follower, dashed candidate.

narrative.overview: The cluster is read the way a spectrogram is read: a charcoal continuum crossed by needle-thin bright lines. Each node is a horizontal lane on one shared time rail whose right edge is now; every Raft event lands as a vertical emission line; node state is drawn as line form, never as fill.
keyCharacteristics: Colour exists only as 1–1.5px hairlines and as text ink, never as a filled surface.
State is line form: doubled = leader, solid = follower, dashed = candidate, dotted = partitioned, struck hatch = down.
One semi-condensed grotesque; hierarchy by size, weight and tracking, not by a second face.
Seams, not shadows: every division is a 1px rule.

rules.name: The One Wavelength, One Job Rule
rules.body: A wavelength never decorates. If a colour appears, it names a Raft state or an outcome.

rules.name: The Doubled Line Rule
rules.body: Doubling outranks everything: only the leader (and the next guide step) is ever drawn doubled.

rules.name: The Legend Voice Rule
rules.body: Labels are always the legend style; never invent a second label size.

dos: Do print every state as text beside its line form (the glyph is decorative).
Do show divergence (lag, uncommitted tail) rather than totals that are equal on every node.
Do label a timed-out write "not confirmed" — its outcome is unknown, not failed.
donts: Don't fill a surface with a wavelength colour.
Don't add shadows, gradients or rounded cards.
Don't use alert() or modals for control-API errors; show them inline in a status region.
